n_obs_steps.description: Number of environment steps worth of observations to pass to the policy (takes the current step and additional steps going back).

horizon.description: Diffusion model action prediction size as detailed in `DiffusionPolicy.select_action`.

n_action_steps.description: The number of action steps to run in the environment for one invocation of the policy. See `DiffusionPolicy.select_action` for more details.

normalization_mapping.description: A dictionary that maps from a str value of FeatureType (e.g., "STATE", "VISUAL") to a corresponding NormalizationMode (e.g., NormalizationMode.MIN_MAX)

drop_n_last_frames.description: The original implementation doesn't sample frames for the last 7 steps, which avoids excessive padding and leads to improved training results.

vision_backbone.description: Name of the torchvision resnet backbone to use for encoding images.

resize_shape.description: (H, W) shape to resize images to as a preprocessing step for the vision backbone. If None, no resizing is done and the original image resolution is used.

crop_ratio.description: Ratio in (0, 1] used to derive the crop size from resize_shape (crop_h = int(resize_shape[0] * crop_ratio), likewise for width). Set to 1.0 to disable cropping. Only takes effect when resize_shape is not None.

crop_shape.description: (H, W) shape to crop images to. When resize_shape is set and crop_ratio < 1.0, this is computed automatically. Can also be set directly for legacy configs that use crop-only (without resize). If None and no derivation applies, no cropping is done.

crop_is_random.description: Whether the crop should be random at training time (it's always a center crop in eval mode).

pretrained_backbone_weights.description: Pretrained weights from torchvision to initialize the backbone. `None` means no pretrained weights.

use_group_norm.description: Whether to replace batch normalization with group normalization in the backbone. The group sizes are set to be about 16 (to be precise, feature_dim // 16).

use_separate_rgb_encoder_per_camera.description: Whether to use a separate RGB encoder for each camera view.

down_dims.description: Feature dimension for each stage of temporal downsampling in the diffusion modeling Unet. You may provide a variable number of dimensions, therefore also controlling the degree of downsampling.

kernel_size.description: The convolutional kernel size of the diffusion modeling Unet.

n_groups.description: Number of groups used in the group norm of the Unet's convolutional blocks.

diffusion_step_embed_dim.description: The Unet is conditioned on the diffusion timestep via a small non-linear network. This is the output dimension of that network, i.e., the embedding dimension.

use_film_scale_modulation.description: FiLM (https://huggingface.co/papers/1709.07871) is used for the Unet conditioning. Bias modulation is used be default, while this parameter indicates whether to also use scale modulation.

gradient_checkpointing.description: Whether to checkpoint the Unet residual blocks during training. This reduces activation memory at the cost of recomputing those blocks during the backward pass.

noise_scheduler_type.description: Name of the noise scheduler to use. Supported options: ["DDPM", "DDIM"].

num_train_timesteps.description: Number of diffusion steps for the forward diffusion schedule.

beta_schedule.description: Name of the diffusion beta schedule as per DDPMScheduler from Hugging Face diffusers.

beta_start.description: Beta value for the first forward-diffusion step.

beta_end.description: Beta value for the last forward-diffusion step.

prediction_type.description: The type of prediction that the diffusion modeling Unet makes. Choose from "epsilon" or "sample". These have equivalent outcomes from a latent variable modeling perspective, but "epsilon" has been shown to work better in many deep neural network settings.

clip_sample.description: Whether to clip the sample to [-`clip_sample_range`, +`clip_sample_range`] for each denoising step at inference time. WARNING: you will need to make sure your action-space is normalized to fit within this range.

clip_sample_range.description: The magnitude of the clipping range as described above.

num_inference_steps.description: Number of reverse diffusion steps to use at inference time (steps are evenly spaced). If not provided, this defaults to be the same as `num_train_timesteps`.

do_mask_loss_for_padding.description: Whether to mask the loss when there are copy-padded actions. See `LeRobotDataset` and `load_previous_and_future_frames` for more information. Note, this defaults to False as the original Diffusion Policy implementation does the same.

excluded.input_features: derived from the dataset version schema by the worker
excluded.output_features: derived from the dataset version schema by the worker
excluded.device: always 'cuda'; the GPU is chosen by the scheduler (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES)
excluded.dtype: torch.dtype is not JSON-serialisable; precision is controlled by train.mixed_precision
excluded.use_peft: set implicitly when train.peft is provided
excluded.push_to_hub: always false; Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action on a model
excluded.repo_id: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.private: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.tags: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.license: Hub push is a separate Hibiscus action
excluded.pretrained_path: set from RunCreate.init_from (model or checkpoint) by the worker
excluded.pretrained_revision: set from RunCreate.init_from by the worker
excluded.compile_model: torch.compile is disabled on the 2-GPU box (P40 unsupported by inductor)
excluded.compile_mode: torch.compile is disabled on the 2-GPU box
